summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on November 12, 2026, attaching a press release announcing an investor call and webcast on November 16, 2026, to review new interim data from its U.S. multicenter REGAIN trial of Alpha DaRT in recurrent glioblastoma, following presentation at the SNO Annual Meeting (Nov. 12-15, 2026). No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. Mechanics involve clinical data disclosure and conference-call logistics only. Watch for trial safety/feasibility readout and any regulatory or partnering implications rather than deal terms.
